title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00147 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: B/o and l/o pump-in sub. M/u double 5 1/2" DP to drill string.
00:15 - 00:30: POOH restricted w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 300 m to 180 m. 2min/std.
00:30 - 01:00: Installed pup with pre-loaded sponge ball. M/u TDS. Circulated 2 x b/u, 2500 LPM/ 13 bar at 50 RPM. Discharged cement contaminated returns.
01:00 - 01:15: POOH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 180 m to 115 m.
01:15 - 01:45: P/u and m/u BOP wash tool and FOSV.
01:45 - 02:45: Washed BOP by pumping SW at 1600 LPM, 80 RPM, 3 x passes.
02:45 - 03:00: Functioned BOP rams and washed additional 3 passes
03:00 - 03:15: Flowchecked well for 10min, static. Meanwhile b/o and l/d BOP washing tool.
03:15 - 03:30: POOH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 120 m to surface.
03:30 - 03:45: L/d EZSV RT.
03:45 - 04:45: Drained riser through b-annulus outlet on WH. Meanwhile installed chains on TDS for pulling diverter. R/u fence around rotary.
04:45 - 05:00: Performed TBT for pulling diverter
05:00 - 07:00: Attempted to pull diverter. Adjusted tension cylinders while holding 3-4 ton overpull.
07:00 - 07:15: Performed TBT with ongoing crew for pulling diverter.
07:15 - 08:15: Pulled diverter and r/b same.
08:15 - 09:00: N/d slipjoint and r/b same. Meanwhile performed pre-skidding checks.
09:00 - 10:00: Load shifted weight from tension cylinders to BOP carrier. N/d tension cylinders meanwhile continued with pre-skidding checks.
10:00 - 10:45: Diconnected BOP connector. Lifted and skidded BOP off well center.
10:45 - 11:00: Removed scaffolding around HP riser.
11:00 - 11:15: R/u equipment to lift HP riser.
11:15 - 12:00: Disconnected nt2 connector on WH. Removed WH hole covers. Pulled HP riser from WH to drill floor. L/d riser.
12:00 - 12:45: Removed scaffolding in moonpool. Meanwhile performed TBT for moving hatches in moonpool. End of report
